incidents.title: Elevated API Latency in AP-SOUTHEAST
incidents.desc: We observed elevated latency (up to 300ms) for link creation API requests originating from the Asia-Pacific region. Traffic was successfully rerouted to our Japan edge nodes within 3 minutes, fully resolving the issue.

incidents.title: Analytics Dashboard Delay
incidents.desc: Click data processing was delayed by approximately 45 seconds due to a sudden 10x spike in global traffic during a major sporting event. Link routing was unaffected. The analytics pipeline autoscaled successfully and cleared the backlog.

incidents.title: Scheduled Database Maintenance
incidents.desc: Routine primary database failover testing was completed successfully. Dashboard access was read-only for 4 minutes during the window. Core link redirection remained fully operational with 0% packet loss.
